About these 3 rides

The earliest start is F(RIDE)day Coffee Ride at 7:15 am; the latest is First Friday Ride at 8:00 pm. After work, 2 start at 5 pm or later. The group waits for everyone on 2 of them (no-drop), and beginners are welcome on 1. All 3 are social rides, plus a Critical Mass. They run 1 every week and 2 once a month. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 18 and Oct 26, 2026.
